{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment")
print(pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (use bins to avoid too many unique values)
# Create age bins: 18-29, 30-44, 45-59, 60+
age_bins = [18, 29, 44, 59, 100]
labels = ['18-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']
df_filtered['age_group'] = pd.cut(df_filtered['customer_age'], bins=age_bins, labels=labels, right=False)

print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs age_group")
print(pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['age_group']))"}
